description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the quality of patient care, foster a positive work environment, and ensure compliance with all regulatory standards. If you are a compassionate leader with a strong clinical background, we encourage you to apply.
As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, including staff management, patient care planning, and quality assurance initiatives. This role is crucial for maintaining high standards of care and promoting the well-being of our residents. We offer a competitive salary and a supportive environment where your leadership will make a significant impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking an experienced Interim MDS Coordinator to join a dedicated team at a skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS. This interim opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented professional ready to step into a crucial role focused on patient assessment and care planning.As the Interim MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating and completing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring accuracy and compliance with federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be vital in developing comprehensive care plans that reflect the needs of our residents.This role prefers a Registered Nurse (RN) with a strong clinical background and a commitment to quality care. Join a supportive environment where your skills will directly impact resident well-being.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator
Proficient knowledge of MDS 3.0 and associated regulatory requirements
Demonstrated ability to conduct comprehensive patient assessments and develop individualized care plans

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Full-time MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Des Moines, IA. This vital role offers a competitive hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00 and the opportunity to contribute significantly to resident care and facility compliance.

The MDS Coordinator is responsible for the timely and accurate completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring compliance with federal and state regulations. You will play a crucial role in the resident assessment process, care planning, and reimbursement, directly impacting the quality of care provided to our residents.

We are looking for a professional who is passionate about quality care and thrives in a collaborative environment. If you are an experienced MDS professional, particularly an RN, looking for a stable full-time opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa (preferred).
Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Comprehensive understanding of MDS 3.0, RAI process, and Medicare/Medicaid regulations.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

description:
Join a premier community health center in Greenville, SC, seeking a dedicated Med-Peds Physician. This is an exceptional opportunity to provide comprehensive care within a supportive environment, offering a highly competitive compensation package and excellent benefits.

We are offering a base salary of $210,000 per year, complemented by a $25,000 guaranteed bonus and an additional $25,000 in potential bonuses. A $9,000 sign-on bonus is available on payday one upon signing a promissory note. Enjoy great benefits and generous Paid Time Off (PTO). While full-time is preferred, we are open to considering Part-time, PRN, or Contract Physician candidates.

If you are an MD or DO specializing in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Med-Peds, and are looking for a role with significant earning potential and work-life balance, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification/Eligibility in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Med-Peds
Current, unrestricted state medical license in South Carolina
salaryOrBonusInfo: Base salary of $210,000 per year with a $25,000 guaranteed bonus and $25,000 in potential bonuses. A $9,000 sign-on bonus is available on payday one upon signing a promissory note. No relocation bonus. Compensation is competitive, exceeding the average for Family Medicine MDs in South Carolina.
